Run an AutoIML audit (convenience wrapper)

Source: R/autoiml.R
autoiml_wrapper.Rd

Convenience wrapper that constructs an AutoIML object and immediately runs it.

Use this function if you want a single-call interface. If you want to inspect or modify configuration prior to running (e.g. ctx$structure), instantiate AutoIML directly.

Usage

autoiml(
  task,
  learner,
  resampling = mlr3::rsmp("cv", folds = 5),
  purpose = c("exploratory", "global_insight", "decision_support", "deployment"),
  quick_start = FALSE,
  seed = 1L,
  config = list(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

task

(mlr3::Task)
The task to audit.

learner

(mlr3::Learner)
The learner to audit. For classification, predict_type = "prob" is required.

resampling

(mlr3::Resampling)
Resampling strategy used for Gate 1. Defaults to 5-fold CV.

purpose

(character(1))
Declared purpose; controls which gates run and how strict the claim scope is. One of "exploratory", "global_insight", "decision_support", "deployment".

quick_start

(logical(1))
If TRUE, runs a reduced set of gates for fast iteration.

seed

(integer(1))
Random seed used for reproducible subsampling in computational gates.

config

(list())
Optional nested configuration list merged into the runtime context ctx (e.g. list(structure = list(sample_n = 200L))).

verbose

(logical(1))
If TRUE, prints a compact run summary after completion.

Value

AutoIMLResult.

Examples

library(mlr3)
task = tsk("penguins")
learner = lrn("classif.rpart", predict_type = "prob")
resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 5)

result = autoiml(task, learner, resampling, purpose = "global_insight", seed = 123)
